player_reviews.comment: Played an intense pickleball tournament with Rahul today. Outstanding sportsmanship and very punctual!
Unreal stamina and midfield distribution! Scored the winning penalty in our Indiranagar 7v7 shootout. Always stays calm even when tackles fly in. Never argues with the referee.
Solid opening batsman. Arrived 15 minutes before slot time for warmups. Tremendous work rate and team ethic.
Great mixed doubles partner! Respects calls, cheers up teammates during tough points, and shows top-tier sportsmanship.
Captain material. Reads the game two steps ahead. Completely organized our defense and was gracious to the opposing team after the match.
Lethal kitchen drops and incredible hand speed in Pickleball doubles! Always positive vibes on the court.
